svg.text: The pipeline bubble
Forward pass, 4 stages, 8 micro-batches: 11 ticks, 32 busy cells of 44
Who is busy at each tick (digit = micro-batch)
stage 0
stage 1
stage 2
stage 3
idle cells: 12 of 44 = 3/11 = 0.273
Bubble = (S-1)/(m+S-1)
micro-batches
more micro-batches, smaller bubble
At S=4 it takes 28 micro-batches to get under 10% idle.
The cost: with all forwards before any backward,
stage 0 holds m micro-batches of activations.
GPipe's rule of thumb is m >= 4 x S
For S=4 that is m=16, where the formula still gives
0.158. The paper reports the overhead as negligible
in its experiments; measure on your own pipeline.
Real run: 2 processes, stage 0 on rank 0 and stage 1 on rank 1, 4 micro-batches
gradients match the single-process model: stage 0 max difference 5.96e-08, stage 1 2.38e-07
